newsitem.title: USA: Edison Int'l ups share buyback by $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: Edison Int'l ups share buyback by $500 mln.

text.p: Edison International said on Friday that it approved an increase in its stock repurchase plan by $500 million.
The company said in a statement on Friday that the move raises the level of potential share repurchase to $800 million from the $300 million previously authorized.
Between February 14, 1995 and September 25, 1996, the company repurchased 14,199,725 shares for about $233 million at an average price of $16.39 a share.
Edison International is the holding company for Southern California Edison, Edison Mission Energy, Edison Capital, Edison Source, and Edison Electric Vehicles.
Edison International has about 434.8 million shares outstanding. Shares of Edison International closed 1/8 lower at 17-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
